candidates.content: She said no to Bela in front of the whole ensemble for the first time: ohne Nebel keine Möwe, out loud, hands shaking after. His text the next morning was Nebel bleibt, and a promise to discuss her tone.
One cigarette at the loading dock on day nine. She wanted it not to count; the number is one, not zero, and not a relapse.
The premiere of Die Möwe moved from Friday the 14th to Saturday the 15th because Jonas has laryngitis.
Ferdi paid twenty of the forty euro from Saturday's taxi; 20 euro still open, promised for next week, and she is keeping count.
Mara-Schatz from Bela is fine one-on-one and not in front of the ensemble. She found out what she meant; do not write it as a change of mind.
Hamburg after the run, at Lotte's; Herr Brösel needs a sitter, and the sitter cannot be Ferdi.
